objectives.description: Identify, write, and connect all 28 Arabic letters in their initial, medial, final, and isolated forms
Apply short and long vowels (fatha, kasra, damma, and their extensions) correctly in reading and writing
Pronounce Arabic sounds including emphatic consonants and pharyngeal sounds correctly
Apply tanwin, shaddah, sukun, and other diacritical marks in reading Arabic texts
Classify Arabic nouns as masculine or feminine and use them correctly in singular, dual, and plural forms
Identify and conjugate basic Arabic verbs in the past, present, and command tenses
Build simple Arabic sentences using subject-verb-object structure and apply definite and indefinite articles
Use common Arabic vocabulary on themes including greetings, family, home, school, and daily activities
Count and use Arabic numbers 1–100 and express dates, time, and quantities correctly
Read simple Arabic texts with correct pronunciation and demonstrate understanding through comprehension questions
Copy, dictate, and write simple Arabic sentences and short paragraphs with correct script
Write simple Arabic compositions on familiar topics using learned vocabulary and structures
Identify themes and moral lessons in simple Arabic literary and religious texts
